senses.gloss:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Wept, weeping.
E.
प्र before रुद to weep, क्त aff.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
1 Rooted, fastened, growing or proceeding from a root.
2 Grown, increased.
3 Born, produced.
m. (-ढः)
The belly.
E.
प्र before रुह to grow, क्त aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Stimulating, exciting.
2 Propitiating.
f. (-ना)
Praise of the author of a drama, &c. in the prelude, to secure the favour of the spectators.
E.
प्र before रुच to, be light, causal v., युच् aff.

m. (-हः)
A bud, a shoot.
E.
प्र before रुह to grow, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि)
Budding, sprouting.
E.
प्ररोह, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं)
Begun, beginning.
E.
प्र and आङ् before रभ to begin, क्त aff.

f. (-ब्धिः)
1 Beginning, commencement.
2 A rope or fastening for an elephant.
E.
प्र and आङ् before रभ to commence, aff. क्तिन्.

m. (-म्भः)
Beginning.
E.
प्र and आङ् before रभि to begin, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Asking, an asker, a solicitor.
E.
प्र before अर्थ to seek, वुन् aff.

nf. (-नं-ना)
Asking, begging.
E.
प्र before अर्थ to ask, aff. युच्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be asked or begged.
n. (-यं)
The third or Dvāpara age of the world.
E.
प्र before अर्थ to ask, अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
One who asks or solicits, a beggar, an inquirer, a solicitor.
E.
प्र before अर्थ to seek, तृच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Asked, begged, solicited.
2 Said, spoken.
3 Obstructed or opposed by an enemy.
4 Killed, hurt.
E.
प्र before अर्थ to ask, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Asking, begging.
E.
प्र before अर्थ to ask, क्तवतु aff.
